facts.fact: AIB reports that the Direction générale de la modernisation de l'état civil (DGMEC) initiated the 31 August to 2 September 2026 training of Pouni's delegated officers and transcribing agents on the VENEEM platform.

AIB reports that the digitalisation operation at Pouni is financed by the Projet régional de gouvernance locale et de soutien (PREGOLS) under budget year 2026; the document names a project, not a state budget line, and does not say who funds the project.
AIB reports that Pouni's civil-status agents were trained from 31 August to 2 September 2026 to enter births, marriages and deaths in VENEEM.

AIB reports that the training covered configuring smartphones and entering civil-status events in real time on the VENEEM platform, at central offices and at secondary centres alike; the document does not say where the record is held.
A 72-hour session at Pouni town hall (Sanguié) from 31 August to 2 September 2026 trained delegated officers and transcribing agents to use VENEEM, per AIB.

systems.owner: Direction générale de la modernisation de l'état civil (DGMEC)
systems.tiers: commune central civil-status offices and secondary centres (Pouni, Sanguié)
